description.zh:
要查询的请求数据的结束时间。使用时间戳表示，单位：秒。

> 必须为整点分钟。
description.en:
The end time of the request data to query. Specify a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

> The value must be on the minute.

description.zh: 要查询的DDoS高防实例的ID列表。
description.en: The IDs of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances to query.

description.zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组。
description.en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not set this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group.

description.zh:

description.en:

> The value must be on the minute.

title.zh: 查询实例的请求来源运营商分布
title.en: Query request source ISP distribution of an instance

descriptions.zh:
本接口用于查询指定时间段内DDoS高防实例的请求来源运营商分布。

> 由于DDoS高防的四层传输层身份统计算法更新，目前本接口返回数据不能反应真实流量的大小，仅可用于计算不同运营商请求数量的比例（即请求的来源运营商分布情况）。如果您想获取请求流量数据，推荐您调用[DescribePortFlowList](~~157460~~)。

### QPS限制

本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用将会被限流，这可能影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
Queries the distribution of request source Internet service providers (ISPs) for an Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance within a specified time period.

> Because the Layer 4 transport-layer identity statistics algorithm of Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium has been updated, the data returned by this operation does not reflect the actual traffic volume. The data can only be used to calculate the proportion of requests from different ISPs (that is, the distribution of request source ISPs). To obtain request traffic data, call [DescribePortFlowList](~~157460~~).

### QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 10 times per second per account. If the number of calls per second exceeds the limit, throttling is triggered. This may affect your business. Call this operation as needed.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo describe-port-view-source-isps --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --end-time 1583683200 --start-time 1582992000 --instance-ids ddoscoo-cn-zvp2eibz0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
